video_title: Latest Minnesota Timberwolves news: De’Aaron Fox, Giannis and more

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' need for a ball-handler or guard for Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: the Wolves could use another ball-handler, they could use another guard, a running mate for Anthony Edwards

text_blocks.speaker: Judd Zulgad
text_blocks.text: The Wolves could use another ball-handler, they could use another guard, a running mate for Anthony Edwards. If the Spurs make De'Aaron Fox and that contract available, I am going to need five first and second-round picks, along with De'Aaron Fox to take him off their hands if I am the Timberwolves.

text_blocks.speaker: Phil Mackey
text_blocks.text: It will be Julius Randle for De'Aaron Fox and several assets is the starting point for that conversation.

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' low-IQ panic basketball in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: that was one of the most embarrassing displays of low-IQ panic basketball in the history of the NBA
quotes.quote: That was one of the most embarrassing displays of low-IQ panic basketball in the history of the NBA playoffs. No hyperbole. That was wild last night.

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' inability to break a trap in high-pressure situations
quotes.excerpt: the Wolves have some of the same short-circuiting things that you've seen with the young Spurs
quotes.quote: The Wolves have some of the same short-circuiting things that you've seen with the young Spurs in the series. How many players, if you put the Wolves in that type of a situation, it's back in the Western Conference Finals, it's NBA Finals, there's a lead slipping away, there's a tsunami of energy from the opposing crowd, how many current Timberwolves do you trust to play high-IQ basketball in a situation like that last night?

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Conley as the only trusted high-IQ player
quotes.excerpt: Well, I mean Mike Conley.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels' offensive potential and need for opportunity
quotes.excerpt: I still have a good amount of belief in Jaden McDaniels, especially on the offensive end
quotes.quote: I still have a good amount of belief in Jaden McDaniels, especially on the offensive end, that there's more there. Give him that opportunity. I'm still a big Naz Reid fan.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's poor decision-making in late-game situations
quotes.excerpt: the De'Aaron Fox play is one of the most magnificently stupid things
quotes.quote: The De'Aaron Fox play is one of the most magnificently stupid things, and I don't think it takes a high basketball IQ to just dribble the ball and wait till you're fouled. It literally, what was he doing?

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving as a potential roster upgrade for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie Irving fits that description. There's other guys that De'Aaron Fox, who might be available, does not fit that description.
quotes.quote: I think that needs to be the top priority the next six weeks when the Wolves look to upgrade their roster. And by the way, Kyrie Irving fits that description. There's other guys that De'Aaron Fox, who might be available, does not fit that description.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's injury history and durability concerns
quotes.excerpt: My bigger concern is durability. Like he hasn't had any sort of catastrophic injury
quotes.quote: My bigger concern is durability. Like he hasn't had any sort of catastrophic injury, but you go back to his Sacramento Kings days, hamstring, ankle, it's been a lot of different type injuries with De'Aaron Fox.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' front office interest in De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: this front office had legit interest in De'Aaron Fox before Sacramento moved him to San Antonio
quotes.quote: This front office had legit interest in De'Aaron Fox before Sacramento moved him to San Antonio. So I'm just saying, I can't completely rule him out.

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Preference for De'Aaron Fox over Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: I'd rather have De'Aaron Fox, because he's 20 million dollars less and I don't have to scrunch my assets
quotes.quote: I'd rather have De'Aaron Fox, because he's 20 million dollars less and I don't have to scrunch my assets.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of Jalen Brunson's late-game decision-making
quotes.excerpt: the stupidity of that play is magnified by that. That should not have been a bang-bang
quotes.quote: The stupidity of that play is magnified by that. That should not have been a bang-bang, oh my god, I couldn't have seen this coming. He literally could have, like they talk about that in baseball. In baseball, they always say you have to be cognizant of what might happen, because when you're not, that's where like a shortstop screws up.

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's role and usage in the closing stretch
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson, a guard and a rookie, really good player, Jalen Brunson inbounding in that situation
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson, a guard and a rookie, really good player, Jalen Brunson inbounding in that situation with Carl-Anthony Towns and his length up in his grill, I thought that was a mistake first guess.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' potential move away from Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: Either the Wolves are out on Giannis and they're going and pursuing other options, or Tim Connelly has retreated
quotes.quote: Either the Wolves are out on Giannis and they're going and pursuing other options, or Tim Connelly has retreated into the shadows and he's no longer working as publicly as maybe he was before the trade deadline.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's potential preference for the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: is there more interest in being in Miami or Boston or just flat out the Eastern Conference?
quotes.quote: Is there more interest in being in Miami or Boston or just flat out the Eastern Conference? My understanding back in February was Giannis was open-minded to teaming up with Anthony Edwards. But is there more interest in being in Miami or Boston or just flat out the Eastern Conference?

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Uncertainty surrounding potential trades for star players
quotes.excerpt: is Kyrie truly available? Will De'Aaron Fox become available?
quotes.quote: Is Kyrie truly available? Will De'Aaron Fox become available? Okay, we know Ja Morant is available, but he just he doesn't make a whole lot of sense to me. Is Zion Williamson available? Is Kevin Durant available? Yes, we believe Giannis is available, that Giannis is moving, but we don't think it'll be here.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Necessity of including Jaden McDaniels in a Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: if you can acquire Giannis, you need to include Jaden McDaniels
quotes.quote: If you can acquire Giannis, you need to include Jaden McDaniels. It stinks, but you do it.

quotes.speaker: Phil Mackey
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Conley's potential future with the Bulls or other teams
quotes.excerpt: he might get that Bulls job, right? Or Portland
quotes.quote: He might get that Bulls job, right? Or Portland. And he's in the mix in Dallas. Like it seems like it's more real than ever.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Lloyd's influence on the Bulls' front office
quotes.excerpt: Matt Lloyd very much impressed the Bulls hierarchy
quotes.quote: Matt Lloyd very much impressed the Bulls hierarchy. I was told money was a factor. So the Bulls ultimately hired the guy from Atlanta, is it Bryson Graham, that I don't know exactly what Matt was looking for contractually, but that Bryson, in all likelihood, now I'm sure the Bulls liked Bryson, don't get me wrong, but just in terms of the contract given to Bryson Graham, able to save a little bit of money.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: High compensation for the Timberwolves' front office
quotes.excerpt: Credit to ownership for paying a lot of money to the front office
quotes.quote: Credit to ownership for paying a lot of money to the front office, because you think about the money Tim Connelly is making, and heck, the idea is to sign him to a contract extension this summer. Then you think about what Matt Lloyd is making, what Dell Demps is making. That's a highly compensated front office over at Mayo Clinic Square.

quotes.speaker: Judd Zulgad
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' draft workout and scouting of prospects
quotes.excerpt: They also had a draft workout on Sunday, so it was jersey unveil day
quotes.quote: They also had a draft workout on Sunday, so it was jersey unveil day. They also had a few guys in, including Bryce Hopkins who played where, St. John's, Providence, Kentucky, and Alex Karaban from UConn. He was in on Sunday. I'm not against Karaban at pick 28.
